steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Wait-wait-wait-wait—! I wasn't trying to spy on your secrets on purpose; this was completely an accident!

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: I just thought this cipher machine would reveal crucial intel about major unsolved cases! That's the only reason I started decoding it!

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: This happens in detective novels all the time! The agency receives a mysterious package that turns out to be a puzzle challenge from some brilliant criminal mastermind!

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Don't worry, I've already destroyed both the original code and the decrypted results. Your secrets are absolutely safe; I give you my word of honor!

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Wha... Christina...? Where am I? Did I sleepwalk again... so tired, going back to bed...

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Sleepwalk... Sleepwalk... Head so fuzzy... Don't remember anything...
